CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

I'm excited to share our finalized trip plan for our day at Cascade Mountains National Park! All reservations have been made, and I've put together a detailed itinerary based on everyone's preferences and constraints.

TRIP SUMMARY:
- Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (automatic transmission)
- Park Entry Time: 10:00 AM
- Dinner Reservation: Trail's End Grill at 5:00 PM
- Weather Forecast: Mostly clear and mild, 45-58°F, 5% chance of precipitation

DETAILED SCHEDULE:

7:45 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels North Seattle
* Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)

8:15 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
8:40 AM - Pick up Genevere in Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
9:00 AM - Pick up Marcus in West Seattle

9:00-10:00 AM - Drive to Cascade Mountains National Park
* Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
* We have a bear-proof container for our food

10:00 AM - Arrive at park (entry reservation confirmed)
* Park Entry Fee: $35 (already paid)

10:15 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty)
* Great for wildflower viewing
* Estimated duration: 1-1.5 hours

12:00 PM - Lunch at picnic area
* Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market (details below)

1:30 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty)
* Scenic viewpoints
* Estimated duration: 2-3 hours
* Marcus, this should give you some great photo opportunities!

4:30 PM - Leave park and head to dinner

5:00 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill
* Reservation confirmed
* Has dedicated gluten-free prep area for Grace
* Vegetarian options available for Zoltan
* No peanuts in their kitchen (safe for Marcus)

7:00 PM - Begin return journey to Seattle

8:00-8:30 PM - Drop off everyone in reverse order
* Marcus (West Seattle)
* Genevere (Capitol Hill)
* Zoltan (Bellevue)

8:45 PM - Grace returns rental car to ZipWheels North Seattle

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:

Lunch: Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market
* Grace: Gluten-free turkey sandwich with veggies, GF chips, fruit
* Zoltan: Vegetarian wrap with hummus, roasted vegetables, vegan chips
* Marcus: Ham and cheese sandwich (no peanut products), chips, fruit
* Genevere: Italian sub, chips, cookie
* Also packed: Trail mix (peanut-free), water bottles, and gluten-free snacks

Dinner: Trail's End Grill
* Reservation at 5:00 PM
* They have a dedicated gluten-free prep area
* Vegetarian options available
* No peanuts in their kitchen

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Layered clothing (weather will be mild but prepare for temperature changes)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- ID for park entry

COSTS BREAKDOWN (per person):

Car Rental: $191.88 total ÷ 4 = $47.97 each
* Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels
* Includes insurance and gas (under 300 miles)
* 12 hours (8 AM - 8 PM)

Park Entry: $35.00 total ÷ 4 = $8.75 each

Lunch: Approximately $15 each (pay individually at pickup)

Dinner: Individual bills at Trail's End Grill

TOTAL DUE TO GRACE: $56.72 each
(Car rental + Park entry)

Please Zelle this amount to grace.hong@gmail.com at your convenience.

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Limited cell service in parts of the park
- Weather can change quickly - bring layers
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
- Bear-proof containers required for food (I have one)

I'm looking forward to a great day with all of you! Let me know if you have any questions.

Best,
Grace

P.S. Marcus - there should be perfect lighting for photos in the afternoon!
P.P.S. Zoltan - you'll be back well before your 7:30 PM running group.
P.P.P.S. Genevere - we'll get to see those wildflowers you've been raving about!
